question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

Meticulous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Precise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Meticulous"** means showing great attention to detail and being extremely careful and precise. (बहुत सावधान और सटीक)

 
 
• **Example:** The artist was meticulous in adding the final touches to her masterpiece.
 
 
 
• **"Precise"** refers to being exact, accurate, or detailed in expression or execution. (सटीक)
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were so precise that there was no room for confusion.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Meticulous'** is **'Precise'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Precise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Negligent** (असावधान): Failing to take proper care in doing something.

 
 
• **Example:** He was negligent in performing his duties, which led to several errors.
 
 
 
• **Careless** (लापरवाह): Not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoiding harm or errors.
 
 
• **Example:** His careless attitude caused the team to miss the deadline.
 
 
 
• **Random** (यादृच्छिक): Made, done, or happening without method or conscious decision.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher selected a random student to answer the question.
